Scenario B (Channel Retest): Price tests lower toward the bottom blue line of the main upward channel before finding fresh buyers. Entry Strategy & Confirmation Entry Trigger: Buy only above ₹8,984.0 . Volume Filter: Wait for good buying volume on the breakout candle to avoid false moves. Clear Invalidation Levels Pattern Weakness: A breach below ₹8,507.5 invalidates the immediate triangle setup and signals a deeper Wave (iv) retest.
